error_text:
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 447 waits for ShareLock on transaction 9030; blocked by process 349.
context: Two transactions deadlock and one is aborted.
root_cause: The transactions lock the same rows in opposite order.
fix: Retry the aborted transaction; order all writes the same way everywhere to stop it recurring.
title: ERROR: deadlock detected
